entity: Alabama Development Office, Game and Fish Division (via Reynolds W. Thrasher)
summary: The Alabama Development Office's Game and Fish Division, responding through Reynolds W. Thrasher, supports controlling off-road vehicles on public lands. They specifically recommend that the Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife prohibit ORV use within National Wildlife Refuges and Wildlife Management Areas, given that these facilities were established for the protection and management of wildlife resources.

statement.text: Executive Order 11644 has been reviewed by personnel of the Game and Fish Division. We agree that off-road vehicles should be controlled on public lands. Inasmuch as National Wildlife Refuges and Wildlife Management Areas were established for the protection, perpetuation and management of wildlife resources, it is strongly recommended that the Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife prohibit areas and trails for off-road vehicles within the boundaries of such facilities.
